steps.text: Clean first: keep only alphanumeric characters, lower-cased, then compare the list with its reverse (or two pointers from both ends). O(n). Edge cases: empty string counts as a palindrome, punctuation and spaces must be ignored, digits must be kept.

Both visible tests pass, but they have no punctuation. For input like 'A man, a plan' my version may compare commas and spaces. Which cases should I add to check that I really ignore non-alphanumerics?
